questions.q: What is the real name of the dog-masked vigilante Doga?
questions.why: Suraj, an orphan raised in a gym, becomes Doga to avenge the murder of his mentors.

questions.q: Which publisher's universe is Doga part of?
questions.why: Doga is a Raj Comics character, shown there as its first and only anti-hero.

questions.q: In which issue did Doga first appear?
questions.why: Doga's first story was the issue called Curfew, published in 1992.

questions.q: In which year was Doga created?
questions.why: Doga came out in 1992, years after Raj Comics' first heroes Nagraj and Dhruva.

questions.q: Which city does Doga operate in as a one-man army against organised crime?
questions.why: Doga settled in Mumbai and wages a merciless war on its gangsters.

questions.q: Who is credited as Doga's co-creator alongside Sanjay Gupta?
questions.why: Writer Tarun Kumar Wahi and Sanjay Gupta created Doga, with Manu as illustrator.

questions.q: Who found the baby who becomes Doga in a garbage dump and raised him?
questions.why: The bandit Halkan Singh raised the foundling Suraj, then abandoned him; Adrak Chacha took him in next.

questions.q: Whose henchmen murder his mentors and push him to become Doga?
questions.why: After Killota's men killed Adrak Chacha and his brothers, Suraj took up the dog mask for revenge.

questions.q: Doga stands out at his publisher as its only what?
questions.why: He is billed as the first and only anti-hero in his publisher's universe, killing rather than arresting criminals.

questions.q: What unusual ability helps Doga gather information on the street?
questions.why: Doga has no superpowers, but he can talk to dogs, which makes them his informants.
